units.source_text: 他先教她调子特殊的乐曲二三首，然后再教富有趣味的大曲。

en.t: He first taught her two or three pieces with unusual tunings, and then taught her larger pieces rich in interest.

units.source_text: 凡四季变调的手法、适应气候寒暖的调弦法等种种重要的技术，无不详细教授。

en.t: He carefully taught her every important technique, from changing modes for the four seasons to tuning the strings to suit the heat or cold of the weather.

units.source_text: 三公主起初颇感困难，后来渐渐体会，终于弹得很纯熟了。

en.t: At first the Third Princess found it quite difficult, but little by little she came to understand, until at last she could play with great skill.

units.source_text: 白昼众人出入频繁，要从容反复地教授“由”和“按”的弹法，很不安心，便改在夜间教授，可以专心一志地体会真髓。

en.t: During the day people were constantly coming and going, so he felt uneasy trying to teach the playing methods of "yu" and "an" slowly and repeatedly; he therefore moved the lessons to the night, when she could concentrate fully and grasp their essence.

units.source_text: 这期间他就向紫夫人乞假，朝朝夜夜在这里教琴。

en.t: During this period he asked Lady Murasaki to excuse him, and morning and night he stayed here teaching the zither.

units.source_text: 明石女御和紫夫人，以前都不曾向源氏学过七弦琴。

en.t: Neither the Akashi Consort nor Lady Murasaki had ever learned the seven-stringed zither from Genji before.

units.source_text: 明石女御听说父亲此时正在弹奏从来不曾听到过的名曲，很想前来听赏。

en.t: When the Akashi Consort heard that her father was now playing celebrated pieces she had never heard before, she longed to come and listen.

units.source_text: 皇上一向不大肯给女御请假，此次好容易允准她暂时归宁，她就专程回六条院听琴。

en.t: The Emperor had never been very willing to grant the Consort leave, but this time he finally allowed her a temporary visit home, so she made a special trip back to Rokujo-in to hear the zither.

units.source_text: 这位女御已经生下两个皇子，现在又已怀胎五月了。

en.t: This Consort had already borne two imperial princes, and now she was five months pregnant again.

units.source_text: 十一月是宫中祭祀之期，她就以孕妇不宜参与祭祀为借口而归宁。

en.t: Since the eleventh month was the time of palace rites, she used the excuse that a pregnant woman should not take part in the ceremonies and returned to her family home.

units.source_text: 十一月过后，皇上就催她回宫。

en.t: After the eleventh month passed, the Emperor urged her to return to the palace.

units.source_text: 但明石女御有此机会夜夜听赏音乐，对三公主不胜欣羡。

en.t: But having this chance to enjoy music night after night, the Akashi Consort could not help envying the Third Princess deeply.

units.source_text: 她怪怨父亲：为什么不教我弹琴呢！

en.t: She reproached her father in her heart: why had he never taught me to play the zither?

units.source_text: 源氏与众不同，最喜爱冬夜的月亮，便在明月照积雪的清光中弹奏符合季节的琴曲。

en.t: Genji was unlike others and loved the moon on winter nights most of all, so in the clear light of the bright moon shining on piled snow, he played zither pieces suited to the season.

units.source_text: 又在侍女中选择略解此道的人，叫她们各尽所长，联合演奏。

en.t: He also chose among the gentlewomen those who had some understanding of the art, and had each use her own strength as they played together.

units.source_text: 此时已近岁暮，紫夫人十分忙碌，各处种种事务，都必须由她亲自调度。

en.t: By then the year was drawing to a close, and Lady Murasaki was extremely busy, for all sorts of affairs in every quarter had to be managed by her personally.

units.source_text: 她常常说：“到了春天，拣个闲静的傍晚，我总要听一听三公主的琴。”

en.t: She often said, "When spring comes, I must choose a quiet evening and listen to the Third Princess play the zither."
Before long, the New Year had passed.
